description: The Institute of Charted Accounts of Sri Lanka - Amendments of SLFRS for SMES (Empower Board Listed Cost)
categorisation: This gazette content involves the adoption and publication of amendments to the Sri Lanka Accounting Standard (SLFRS) for Small and Medium-sized Entities by the Institute of Chartered Accountants of Sri Lanka under the authority of the Sri Lanka Accounting and Auditing Standards Act, No. 15 of 1995. This constitutes regulatory framework and compliance requirements, falling under Legal/Regulatory matters rather than government structure/personnel or other specialized categories.
